generic.enter: F2, Del, F10, F1 or Esc (the maker logo screen usually shows the key)

steps.ahci: Look for SATA Mode / SATA Operation / SATA Configuration (often under Advanced, Integrated Peripherals or Storage) and choose AHCI. Save and exit.
steps.uefi: Look for Boot Mode / Boot List Option / UEFI Boot and choose UEFI. Turn CSM / Legacy Support off. Save and exit.
steps.secureboot: Look for Secure Boot (under Boot or Security). Choose Enabled. It needs UEFI mode, and on some PCs the Secure Boot keys must be set to Default or Factory first.
steps.legacy: Look for Boot Mode / Legacy Support / CSM and choose Legacy (or turn CSM on).

generic.note: These are the usual menu names; your BIOS may use slightly different words.

steps.ahci: Settings or Advanced > SATA Operation (or Storage > SATA/NVMe Operation) > AHCI.
steps.uefi: Settings > Boot Sequence or General > Boot Sequence > UEFI. Turn Legacy Option ROMs off.
steps.secureboot: Boot Configuration > Secure Boot > Enable Secure Boot.

makers.enter: F10 (Esc then F10 on some models)

steps.ahci: System Configuration or Advanced > SATA Device Mode (or Device Configurations > SATA Emulation) > AHCI.
steps.uefi: Advanced or System Configuration > Boot Options > Legacy Support: Disabled (UEFI Boot Mode: Enabled).
steps.secureboot: Advanced or Boot Options > Secure Boot Configuration > Secure Boot: Enabled.

makers.enter: F1 or F2 (ThinkPad: Enter, then F1); some models have a Novo button

steps.ahci: Configuration > Storage (or Config > Serial ATA) > SATA Controller Mode (or Option) > AHCI (not Compatibility).
steps.uefi: Startup > UEFI/Legacy Boot > UEFI Only (or Both with UEFI first). Turn CSM Support off.
steps.secureboot: Security > Secure Boot > Secure Boot: Enabled.

steps.ahci: Advanced > SATA Configuration > SATA Mode Selection > AHCI.
steps.uefi: Boot > Launch CSM: Disabled (Advanced Mode, F7).
steps.secureboot: Boot > Secure Boot > OS Type: Windows UEFI mode.

makers.boot_menu: F12 (turn it on first in Main > F12 Boot Menu)

steps.uefi: Main or Boot > Boot Mode > UEFI.
steps.secureboot: Security > Set Supervisor Password first; then Boot > Secure Boot > Enabled.

steps.ahci: Settings > Advanced > Integrated Peripherals > SATA Mode > AHCI.
steps.uefi: Settings > Boot > CSM / Boot Mode Select > UEFI.

steps.ahci: Peripherals > SATA Configuration > SATA Mode Selection > AHCI.

makers.enter: F2 (or hold F2 while powering on)
Hold the Volume Up button while pressing the power button
makers.boot_menu: Hold the Volume Down button while pressing the power button

steps.uefi: Surface PCs are UEFI only; there is no legacy mode to turn off.
steps.secureboot: PC information or Security > Secure Boot > Microsoft only.

steps.ahci: Advanced > SATA Operation > AHCI (older versions show ATA / AHCI). On a PC that is already in AHCI mode there is nothing to change.

models.note: Legacy BIOS only: no UEFI, no Secure Boot, no Windows 11. Keep MBR.
